topic: Carpal tunnel syndrome: median nerve compression, Phalen, EMG, conservative vs surgical

source.title: Carpal tunnel syndrome
source.whyItFits: Open clinical review stating that CTS diagnosis uses history, examination, and electrophysiology, that individual provocative tests are not diagnostic alone, and listing splints and local steroid among non-surgical options. The stored AAOS summary did not contain the recommendations themselves.
